description:

A "SAP Service and Asset Manager Architect" is a technical expert who designs and implements solutions using SAP's Service and Asset Manager module, specializing in managing and maintaining an organization's physical assets throughout their lifecycle, by defining system architecture, integrating with other SAP modules, and ensuring efficient workflows for maintenance activities across the entire asset management process, often utilizing mobile capabilities for field technicians to access critical asset data and work orders.

Requirements Gathering:
Understand business needs and translate them into functional specifications for SAP Service and Asset Manager implementation, including asset classification, maintenance strategies, work order management, and reporting requirements.

  • Deep Expertise in SAP Service and Asset Manager: Comprehensive understanding of SAP Service and Asset Manager functionalities, including work orders, notifications, asset hierarchies, maintenance plans, condition monitoring, and mobile capabilities.
  • SAP Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with overall SAP architecture, integration points, and data flow across different modules within the SAP ecosystem.
Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in SAP configuration tools, ABAP programming (if needed), and knowledge of database concepts.
  • Business Process Analysis: Ability to analyze business processes related to asset management and translate them into effective system solutions.

We are seeking experienced data analysts with a specialization in Automotive and Captive Lending Accounting/Financial Reporting to support the mapping of reporting data to multiple source systems. • Must adhere to Client’s Drug and Alcohol-free workplace policy.

General

Daily

Check all trash cans at least once per day (1N, 2N, 4N). Trashcans must always have liners and be wiped down with Alpet wipes when soiled.

Welcome Group, Inc. is seeking a Corporate Director of Finance & Accounting to oversee the financial operations, strategic planning, and reporting of our growing hospitality platform. Welcome Group currently owns and operates 12 hotel properties, with plans to expand through third-party management agreements in addition to continued ownership and development.
This position will work closely with Eight Form, our asset management and development arm, to ensure financial alignment on new builds, redevelopments, and capital projects while also supporting Welcome Group’s existing and third-party management portfolio.
The role is based in Santa Monica, CA (corporate headquarters), with the option to sit in San Diego, CA (via Eight Form’s Industrious office membership). While travel to hotel properties is expected, this position is not remote.
Reporting directly to the President of Welcome Group, the Director will oversee the Corporate Controller and provide leadership to all on-property finance teams.
The ideal candidate combines deep hospitality finance expertise with strong leadership skills, strategic vision, and the ability to leverage technology, AI, and predictive analytics to optimize business performance across a diverse and expanding portfolio.
Experience working with centralized accounting offshore teams (particularly in India) is strongly preferred. Candidates should be comfortable coordinating across time zones and collaborating effectively with offshore resources to ensure smooth project execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Strategy & Growth
    • Develop and execute corporate financial strategies to support growth, profitability, and expansion into third-party hotel management.
    • Partner with ownership and Eight Form’s development team on long-term planning, capital allocation, and acquisitions.
  • Budgeting, Forecasting & Analysis
    • Oversee the preparation of property-level and consolidated budgets and forecasts.
    • Lead variance analysis and deliver actionable insights to drive operating performance.
    • Ensure compliance with USALI and hospitality accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting
    • Deliver timely and accurate consolidated financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).
    • Present financial results, risks, and opportunities to ownership, lenders, and executive leadership.
    • Prepare board and investor reporting as needed.
  • Policies, Controls & Compliance
    • Establish and enforce internal controls, SOPs, and financial policies across all properties.
    • Oversee multi-state payroll and tax compliance.
    • Ensure readiness for external audits and alignment with GAAP.
  • Cash Flow & Risk Management
    • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, and debt covenant compliance.
    • Develop strategies to mitigate financial risk and optimize working capital.
  • Technology & Data Infrastructure
    • Lead the transition and ongoing adoption of NetSuite ERP across the organization.
    • Modernize financial systems, reporting tools, and data management.
    • Champion adoption of AI, predictive analytics, and data visualization tools to enhance forecasting and decision-making.
  • Team Leadership
    • Provide direct oversight of the Corporate Controller.
    • Lead and mentor on-property finance and accounting teams, fostering a culture of accountability, development, and continuous improvement.
    • Establish clear performance standards and reporting consistency across all properties.
  • Stakeholder Partnership
    • Collaborate with operations, development, and asset management teams to align financial strategy with business goals.
    • Support financial due diligence, onboarding, and integration of new third-party management contracts and acquisitions.
  • Travel
    • Conduct regular site visits to properties for financial reviews, team leadership, and operational alignment.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration required; MBA or CPA strongly preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 10 years in finance and accounting leadership, with at least 5 years in a hospitality industry senior role (multi-property experience preferred).
  • Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of GAAP, USALI, audit processes, and multi-state payroll/tax compliance.
  • Systems & Technology: Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and NetSuite ERP implementation and management (required). Comfort with AI-driven tools and BI platforms.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead multi-property finance teams, including Controllers and on-property staff.
  • Strategic Acumen: Track record of driving financial performance, supporting acquisitions/development, and building scalable processes for growth.
  • Communication: Strong ability to distill complex financial data into actionable insights for non-financial stakeholders.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: $150,000 – $200,000, plus potential performance bonus.
  • Full-time, senior leadership position.
  • Health and dental insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and company holidays
  • Primary office location: Santa Monica, CA (Welcome Group headquarters), with the option to use Eight Form’s Industrious membership in San Diego, CA.

Why Join Welcome Group

  • Lead the financial strategy for a growing hospitality platform that owns, operates, and soon will manage third-party hotels.
  • Partner directly with Eight Form, our asset management and development arm, to align financial strategy with new builds, redevelopments, and capital projects.
  • Play a critical role in embedding AI and predictive analytics into hospitality finance and decision-making.
  • Collaborate directly with ownership, lenders, and senior leadership to drive performance.
  • Oversee and mentor finance teams across 12 properties, with responsibility for scaling to future third-party managed hotels.
  • Join an entrepreneurial, growth-oriented environment where your expertise will shape the next phase of the company’s evolution.
